name: TDK
verdict: TDK Corporation of Japan, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange; its largest disclosed holders are custodial trust accounts. Nothing found.
note: Also an Official Partner of Formula E itself (fiaformulae.com/en/partners, fetched 2026-09-25) and new official technology partner of the Porsche Formula E Team from Season 12 (2025/26). Rating note: no state or state-fund holder at 5% or more (Government of Norway 1.29%) and no human-rights finding against TDK located; TDK was approached over the ASPI Xinjiang supplier allegations and responded it had no dealings with the named suppliers (no finding).
